raw_text: FACT CHECK: Viral video claiming to show an IAF pilot making anti-India statements is a deepfake. Our analysis using multiple forensic tools confirms the video was synthetically generated. The lip-sync artifacts are clearly visible at 0.25x speed, and the audio spectral analysis reveals splicing at three distinct timestamps. ISPR's official channels shared this video hours before it went viral on Indian social media, suggesting a coordinated information operation timed to coincide with the upcoming general elections. This follows a pattern of AI-generated military disinformation we've documented across South Asia since late 2023.
